capabilities: Define profile-based property selectors with cascading AND/OR dependency rules
Display human-friendly labels for frontmatter keys without renaming them
Fill empty Text or List properties with context-valid defaults
Route notes into profile default folders while preserving internal links
Inspect, register, bulk-rename, or remove orphaned frontmatter keys
extras: Optional standalone Python migration tool (tools/convert_legacy_vault.py, requires Python 3.10+ and PyYAML) converts legacy selector. vaults with dry-run previews and backups. Maintained via voluntary GitHub Sponsors; sponsorship does not unlock functionality. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The visible property editor depends on Obsidian's internal rendering, so maintainers should test after Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: a modified and rebranded derivative of the MIT-licensed Custom Selectors Obsidian plugin originally published by @hodie
problem: Obsidian's property editing offers flat, unscoped options with no way to define dependent option sets, friendly labels, or safe cleanup of inconsistent frontmatter keys.

relations.evidence: TaxoFlow Properties is a modified and rebranded derivative of the MIT-licensed Custom Selectors Obsidian plugin
